transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just finished your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or how you're getting on with your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you don't have any at the moment, your GP should be able to provide some more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that’s helpful to know. Another thing: I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, that's quite normal! It's common for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. 

If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside. However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying that! One last question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That depends on how long it's been since your surgery. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

How long ago was your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It's been about a week since my surgery. Thanks for the help with my questions! I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Brilliant! So just to confirm - have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, Dora, you’ve answered all my questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help. Take care and best of luck with your recovery!

verdict.label: pass
